verdict.rationale: Justworks' own docs clearly show W-2 employee payroll: it collects W-4 withholding data at enrollment and supports payroll reports and a Pay > Make a Payment flow. Contractor payment is only implied by a single payroll-adjustment note that refers to an "employee or contractor name, payment type, and date of payment." That mention suggests contractor payments run through the same platform but does not document how. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a 1099 contractor payment workflow, 1099 form generation/filing, contractor onboarding, and independent or hands-on confirmation that W-2 and 1099 payments run side by side.
